### Weather zones

Defined in `data/config/weather.yaml`. Zones spawn per biome tick, drift, and expire. Force one with `/weather`, inspect active zones with `/weather-forecast`.

| Type | Biomes | Spawn rate/tick | Duration (ticks) | Radius | Drift |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RAIN` | plains, forest | 0.0002 | 1200–12000 | 48.0–192.0 | 0.1 |
| `STORM` | plains, forest, mountains | 0.00005 | 600–3600 | 32.0–128.0 | 0.15 |
| `SNOW` | tundra, mountains | 0.0003 | 2400–24000 | 64.0–256.0 | 0.05 |
| `FOG` | forest, plains, mountains | 0.0001 | 3000–18000 | 32.0–96.0 | 0.02 |
